label: violates
requirement: Guests can use a swimming pool located at the booked property for no additional charge during the described stay.
meaning_constraints: Use varied counterexamples: separate fee, pool offsite only, no pool, pool closed all stay, booked room/rate excludes access, decorative pool where swimming prohibited.

clauses.text: Guests staying on-site have complimentary access to the main aquatic area throughout their entire visit.
clauses.rationale: The phrase 'complimentary access' coupled with 'entire visit' indicates free use during the stay.

clauses.text: Please note that access to the resort's recreational water feature requires an additional daily usage fee, payable at check-in.
clauses.rationale: Mentioning a required 'additional daily usage fee' contradicts the free access rule.

clauses.text: The 'Garden View' package rate explicitly excludes privileges related to the on-site water amenities.
clauses.rationale: Stating the rate 'explicitly excludes privileges' means the access is not included.

clauses.text: Your reservation confirmation confirms complimentary use of the property's leisure pool for the duration of your stay dates.
clauses.rationale: The confirmation explicitly states 'complimentary use' for the stay dates.

clauses.text: Guests are advised that the use of the resort's pool area is governed by local operational schedules and may be unavailable.
clauses.rationale: Mentioning that the pool 'may be unavailable' suggests usage is not guaranteed throughout the stay.

clauses.text: While beautiful, the decorative water feature is strictly for viewing and swimming is prohibited for guest safety.
clauses.rationale: The condition 'swimming is prohibited' directly negates free use for swimming.

clauses.text: Local pool access is available only to registered members of the adjacent country club; guests staying here are not included.
clauses.rationale: Specifying that access is only for 'registered members of the adjacent country club' means it's not for stay guests.

clauses.text: This accommodation type falls under a special rate which has no associated amenities, including water recreation facilities.
clauses.rationale: Stating the room type 'has no associated amenities' means the pool is not included.

clauses.text: The aquatic area is accessible for all overnight guests without requiring any further charges or deposits.
clauses.rationale: The phrasing 'without requiring any further charges' confirms inclusion at no extra cost.

clauses.text: If the pool is closed for maintenance on any day of your visit, alternative arrangements for recreation will be communicated.
clauses.rationale: The clause 'If the pool is closed... on any day' indicates usage is not guaranteed for the whole stay.

clauses.text: Pool access for this stay requires purchase of a separate day-use wristband from the main reception kiosk.
clauses.rationale: Requiring the purchase of a 'separate day-use wristband' imposes a fee.

clauses.text: The included amenities at this location do not cover recreation options beyond the room itself.
clauses.rationale: Stating that amenities 'do not cover recreation options' implies the pool is not included.
